## [v0.2.9] - 2026-11-06

### Added

- Added optional PhononSynth support with model, voice, and prepared-text synthesis
- Added read-only bundle render inspection and in-memory RenderPlan APIs
- Added static AkinVox multispeaker voices with language-aware Kokoro selection

### Changed

- Changed PhononSynth preflight to honor authoritative fit and reject incompatible APIs

### Fixed

- Fixed book reports to enforce the shared 2 MiB limit and omit persisted execution fingerprints
- Fixed Supertonic option normalization for unset and explicit seeds

## [v0.2.8] - 2026-10-31

### Added

- Added Chatterbox model installation and quality-aware status reporting with actionable missing-profile guidance
- Added RenderProfile reidentification and bundle comparison against immutable profile snapshots
- Added deterministic Kokoro pronunciation lexicon discovery, local G2Lex pinning, and compatibility diagnostics
- Added Kitten pronunciation-source support with named lexicons, pinned G2Lex files, and optional linguistic context
- Added versioned trailing-silence normalization while preserving timings and cache validity
- Added validated say-as character interpretation controls through planning, capacity splitting, and Kokoro synthesis
- Added parenthetical pause boundaries and exposed normalized speech composition in profile inspection

### Changed

- Changed JSON metadata for engine, model, voice, and render diagnostics to use portable path serialization
- Changed SoproSynth request-contract compatibility checks and actionable measurement diagnostics

### Fixed

- Fixed PocketSynth output normalization to the shared full-scale PCM safety policy and clipping metadata recording
- Fixed engine failure diagnostics with bounded redaction and actionable Kitten model-download context

<!-- generated by releaseledger -->
